title: Forgetting is Competition: Rethinking Unlearning as Representation Interference in Diffusion Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenge of unlearning specific concepts (objects, styles, and copyrighted characters) in diffusion models for safety and compliance. While it evaluates the removal of 'nudity' and 'violence' as part of safety-driven unlearning, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
